title: Own compatibility comparator over the attribute manifests and format fixtures (I18)
question: knowledge/architecture#api-compatibility leaves the I18 comparison tool to P4: a structural BC checker such as Roave BackwardCompatibilityCheck or a generator diff. Which tool, and how is the baseline chosen and protected?

options.text: Own comparator bin/api-compat.php over the attribute manifests (publication kind, members, parameter names/defaults, namedArguments, enum closed/open, contracts, facade, roots) and the format fixtures listed in a root compatibility.json, with the D9 rule set; baseline = newest stable tag vX.Y.Z (X >= 1) reachable from HEAD, else the candidate sha pinned in compatibility.json; a PR touching compatibility.json needs the label compat-baseline; a drill in a throwaway clone proves rejection of real breaks. No new dependency.
The own comparator plus roave/backward-compatibility-check as a dev tool with an ignore list for internal types.

context: P4 design session 2026-10-14. Roave checks PHP signatures of every non-@internal symbol but does not know the #[Api]/#[Spi] publication kinds, the Implement/Call split, the closed/open enum class (D15) or the non-PHP formats, and would need an ignore list for ~190 internal types plus BetterReflection as dependency. Owner answer M17: «Свой по манифесту (Recommended)».
decision: A — Own comparator bin/api-compat.php over the attribute manifests (publication kind, members, parameter names/defaults, namedArguments, enum closed/open, contracts, facade, roots) and the format fixtures listed in a root compatibility.json, with the D9 rule set; baseline = newest stable tag vX.Y.Z (X >= 1) reachable from HEAD, else the candidate sha pinned in compatibility.json; a PR touching compatibility.json needs the label compat-baseline; a drill in a throwaway clone proves rejection of real breaks. No new dependency.
rationale: Owner M17 chose the recommended option; the manifest already records exactly the facts the D9 compatibility rules need, so the comparison adds no dependency and no second notion of the supported surface.
consequences: New files: compatibility.json, bin/api-compat.php, bin/compat-drill.sh, bin/compat-baseline-guard.sh, bin/test-compat-baseline-guard.sh, tests/Arch/CompatibilityTest.php, .github/workflows/compatibility.yml; composer script api:compat.
The rule set is knowledge/p4-execution#compatibility; a rule change after 1.0 is a release decision.
Before the first stable tag the baseline is the pointer: provisional (P4.3), frozen candidate (P4.8).
